jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – Observability
jobs.description: Department: Platform Infrastructure Location: Berlin, Germany Team description You'll join the newly formed Developer Experience team, which improves how around 700 SumUp engineers build, ship, and observe software. The team builds the internal tools, services, and abstractions that make infrastructure invisible to product teams. That includes modernising an observability stack that has grown organically and shaping what useful debugging looks like for both engineers and AI agents. This role is software engineering first and DevOps aware second. You'll define open-ended problems before solving them, and you'll build agreement across product engineering, Cloud Infrastructure and Site Reliability Engineering. What you'll do Design, build and evolve services for developer tooling, such as cost reporting, observability pipelines, internal APIs and command line tools Build and extend the internal observability platform so systems are easy for developers to understand and act on Take ownership of components in the observability stack (Loki, Grafana, Prometheus, Alloy and exporters) and improve them Explore what telemetry and debugging context AI agents need, compared with human engineers Create automation, self-service features, and integrations that reduce manual work for product engineering teams Lead design discussions, write and review RFCs, mentor mid-level and junior engineers, and raise standards through code review What you'll bring Strong software engineering fundamentals (Go preferred), with a proven track record of shipping production backend services, command-line tools, or platform tooling. Solid understanding of observability and OpenTelemetry (metrics, logs, traces, SLIs and SLOs) and hands-on experience building observability tooling or integrations. Familiarity with Honeycomb or Grafana is a strong plus. Working knowledge of Kubernetes as a user, and comfort with Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD, and CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions to deliver your own services.

jobs.title: Head of Medical Coding, Germany
jobs.description: At Parallel, we build AI agents that help healthcare organizations automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding. Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost to manual, repetitive administrative tasks. Legacy software hasn't helped: it has made work slower, more complex and more frustrating for care teams. We believe AI agents can change this. Our technology combines large language models with system-level automation to do real work inside existing hospital tools. No integration, no disruption. Our first agent automates coding and frees up time for medical teams to focus on patients. We launched in 2024 and already have 800+ customers and a team of 30+ people. We are backed by top-tier investors (Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Hexa, Frst, Kima Ventures, Better Angle and the CEO of Mistral AI), and this is just the beginning. The future of healthcare isn't just digital, it's automated. Come help us build it! The role As Head of Medical Coding, Germany, you will be our German coding authority and the first coding expert on our founding German team. You will teach our AI engineers how German DRG coding really works, settle the hard cases, and make sure every suggestion we make holds up in an MD audit. You are the German equivalent of the DIM physician who helped us build Parallel in France. Parallel uses AI to take administrative work off hospital teams, starting with inpatient coding. Our agents read the full patient record before billing, find what was documented but not coded, and coders validate every suggestion. We work with around 100 hospitals and clinics in France and are launching in Germany in 2027. Reports to: Paul Lafforgue, CEO and co-founder, until the GM Germany joins. You work closely with Dr. Quentin Jarrion, our physician coding lead in France. Location: Berlin or Munich, hybrid. jobs.title: Expansion Strategy Lead (f/m/d)
jobs.description: At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money . Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience. We are scaling fast and investing heavily in expanding our international footprint. Now, we are looking for an Expansion Lead to help us grow our presence across Europe. About the role: As Expansion Lead, you will join our Strategy team, working directly with our Head of Strategy, Tine von Villiez , to drive Upvest's expansion into new markets and scale our presence in existing ones. You will own the end-to-end process of evaluating, planning and executing market entry - from market sizing and regulatory assessment to go-to-market execution and post-launch optimisation. You will run expansion as a cross-functional programme, working day to day with commercial, product and engineering, legal/compliance and operations, with direct exposure to senior leadership and to clients in each new market. jobs.title: (Senior) Process Manager (all genders)
jobs.description: Wie arbeiten fünf Teams in einem Department über fünf Länder hinweg, wenn AI sie bei der Skalierung unterstützt? Genau das gestaltest du bei Wemolo. Als (Senior) Process Manager (all genders) bist du die erste Person in unserem Operational-Excellence-Team mit vollem Fokus auf Prozesse. Gemeinsam mit dem Team Lead Operational Excellence und dem Operations Management entscheidest du, welche Schritte wegfallen, einfacher werden oder an AI und Automatisierung gehen. What to expect Process Map: Du baust die End-to-End-Prozesslandschaft unseres Operations Department auf und hältst sie aktuell. Dabei startest du beim Big Picture und gehst dort in die Tiefe, wo Teams Arbeit aneinander übergeben. Prozess-Redesign: Gemeinsam mit den Teams findest du heraus, wo es hakt und warum. Daraus entwickelst du Zielprozesse, die über Teams und Länder hinweg funktionieren. AI-First: Für jeden Prozessschritt entscheidest du: streichen, vereinfachen, an AI übergeben oder automatisieren. Du schreibst die Anforderungen für unsere AI- und Automation-Kolleg:innen und testest, was sie liefern. Standards & Ownership: Mit den Leads legst du Prozessstandards fest und benennst klare Process Owner. So wird Continuous Improvement Teil des Alltags. Projekte: Projekte rund um Prozesse, Rollen und Change leitest du selbst. Bei technischen Projekten bist du von Anfang an dabei und gestaltest die Prozessseite mit. Messbarer Impact: Du machst sichtbar, was deine Arbeit bewirkt, zum Beispiel kürzere Durchlaufzeiten, weniger manuelle Arbeit und mehr dokumentierte Kernprozesse mit klarem Owner. Aufbauarbeit: Als erste Person mit vollem Prozessfokus legst du die Grundlagen. Du entscheidest mit, mit welchen Methoden und Templates wir arbeiten und wie wir Projekte aufsetzen und übergeben. Inspire us by Erfahrung: Du hast mindestens 4 Jahre Erfahrung in Prozess- oder Operations-Beratung, Operational Excellence, Business Process Management oder einer operativen Rolle mit Prozessverantwortung. Das Level richten wir

Our dynamic organization allows you to work across functional business pillars, contributing your ideas, experiences, diverse thinking, and a strong mindset. Are you ready? Our solutions focus on the big-ticket value items on the C-Suite agenda, providing a deep link between business and IT to help you lead with influence beyond the back-office remit. For more information and details on the services we provide and the clients we serve, please visit or careers page. The role As a Service Designer at Infosys Consulting, you help our clients understand what their customers really need and turn those insights into services that work seamlessly across every touchpoint – digital and physical, frontstage and backstage. You bring a solid foundation in human-centered design, CX strategy and digital transformation, and you understand how service experiences connect to the client’s marketing, CRM, customer care and operations. Working directly with client stakeholders, you lay the groundwork for a holistic service and CX strategy, establish standards, processes and ways of working, and build the client’s own capability. Denn wir suchen für 15-20 Stunden pro Woche eine/n engagierte/n Werkstudent/in im Bereich Marketing. Bei uns hast du die Möglichkeit, in einem dynamischen Team an vielseitigen Projekten mitzuwirken und deine kreativen Ideen einzubringen. Zu uns: Die Volt Venture GmbH ist ein mittelständisches Unternehmen aus Münster, das mit der Marke Clevertronic im Re-Commerce Bereich erfolgreich ist. Clevertronic ist der Rundum-Partner fürs Smartphone-Leben: Wir kaufen gebrauchte Smartphones, Tablets und weitere Elektronik an, bereiten sie professionell auf und geben ihnen als geprüfte Refurbished-Produkte ein zweites Leben. Mit rund 100 Kolleg:innen, mehr als 50 Mio. Euro Umsatz und profitablem Wachstum ohne Investoren gehören wir zu den größten Refurbishing-Unternehmen Deutschlands. Jetzt entwickeln wir Clevertronic zu einer Plattform rund ums Smartphone-Leben weiter - mit neuen Produkten, Geschäftsmodellen und Märkten. Aufgaben Als Werkstudent/in Marketing bei Clevertronic erwarten dich vielfältige und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben: Content Creation : Verfassen von SEO-optimierten Texten, Blogbeiträgen und Landingpages, die unsere Zielgruppe ansprechen und unsere Online-Präsenz stärken Social Media Management : Erstellen und Planen von ansprechenden Social Media Beiträgen für unsere verschiedenen Kanäle E-Mail-Marketing : Gestaltung und Versand von Newslettern, die unsere Kunden begeistern und informieren Marktanalyse : Unterstützung bei der Analyse von Markttrends und Wettbewerbsaktivitäten, um unsere Marketingstrategie stetig zu verbessern Projektarbeit : Mitarbeit an verschiedenen Marketingprojekten, von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung Qualifikation Was du mitbringen solltest: Eingeschriebene/r Student/in im Bereich Marketing, Kommunikationswissenschaften, BWL oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang Erste Erfahrung im Bere

jobs.title: Senior SAP / ABAP Engineer
jobs.description: You'll own the layer where Causa Prima meets the SAP systems our customers run their finance on. Most of the data we care about lives inside S/4HANA and ECC, and you'll be the person who decides how we read from and write to those systems safely, at scale, across very different customer landscapes. This is a senior individual contributor role with real architectural ownership: you'll set the patterns the rest of the team builds on, and you'll be the technical voice in the room when a customer's SAP team asks hard questions. What you'll do Own the add-on: Architectural ownership of our ABAP add-on in its registered namespace: how it's structured, released, and kept upgrade-safe. Clean core and certification: Drive us toward clean core compliance and SAP certification, using released CDS and public APIs wherever they exist. SAP data and APIs: Design how financial data moves in and out of SAP (OData, BAPIs, RFCs, IDocs) at production volume. FI/CO domain leadership: Turn accounting reality into code: posting logic, payment terms and Skonto, open item management, account determination, tax codes. Set the engineering bar: Define the conventions and raise the standard for testability, ABAP Unit coverage, and static analysis (ATC, SCI). Data structuring across landscapes: Shape heterogeneous customer setups (charts of accounts, company codes, country versions, ECC versus S/4HANA) into one consistent model. Reliability and auditability: Build for idempotency, reconciliation, and traceability, so every action against a customer system is explainable after the fact. Customer-facing technical lead: Lead technical discovery and onboarding with finance teams, SAP admins, and customer Basis teams. What we're looking for At least 6 years of hands-on ABAP development on S/4HANA and ECC (not configuration with some coding attached). jobs.title: Head of IT and Security
jobs.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. WHY JOIN US Work on a civilisation-scale problem - Clean, baseload fusion energy is one of the few genuinely world-changing challenges, and every hire directly accelerates the path to a working stellarator. Grow as fast as the company does - With headcount set to roughly 5x in a few years and major technical milestones ahead on the path to our demo machine and first power plant, your role grows under you; today's hire is tomorrow's function lead. Tackle problems that don't exist elsewhere - Fusion sits at a rare intersection of deep-tech R&D, industrial procurement, government relations, and venture financing, so non-tech functions face challenges no other workplace can offer. YOUR IMPACT As our Head of IT & Security in Munich, you will own IT and security across all of our sites: reliable systems so our people can work quickly, protection for one of the most valuable bodies of fusion IP in Europe, and the evidence that our controls work. WHAT YOU WILL DO Lead and grow our IT Operations and Security team

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner - Tech (f/m/d)
jobs.description: This is for the person who's looking for their next growth challenge in recruiting. You can close a hard search, you know how to talk to candidates who aren't looking, and your current role has started to feel a little too comfortable. At eleQtron, you can still help write our next chapter and decide how we get there. We build quantum computers, with about 130 people across Hamburg and Siegen. Most of the people we need are physicists, engineers and software specialists who are sought-after talent. We’re still shaping how eleQtron finds them, how it tells them why they should join, and how we evolve our approach to hiring. That's the job you can define. What you'll do You'll sit inside our technical teams as their talent partner. You'll learn how each team works, where it’s strong and where the gaps are. You'll shape the brief and the bar with the hiring manager, pushing back where you have to. You'll run our hardest searches yourself, from mapping the market to closing the offer and helping people relocate. Most of those hires will be people you found rather than people who applied. With the team, you'll work out why a strong scientist or engineer should join eleQtron, and you'll make sure the people we want to hire hear it, through universities, conferences and research networks as well as the usual (and unusual) channels. You'll build the way we hire: structured interviews, scorecards and debriefs that every technical team uses, with the data to show whether they work. You'll coach our hiring managers and interviewers to that standard. You'll have the freedom to be creative in how you source, and to use AI for the research and admin, so your time goes on judgement and on conversations with people. This is for you if You've outgrown your current role and want to build something. You start things without waiting to be asked, and you finish them. You move with urgency when the picture is still unclear. You'd rather shape an employer brand than inherit one. Hard tech

jobs.title: Senior SAP S/4HANA Interface Cutover Lead (Freelance)
jobs.description: Mandatory Expertise – Bitte vor der Bewerbung lesen Für ein langfristiges SAP S/4HANA-Transformationsprogramm bei einem großen deutschen Unternehmen suchen wir einen erfahrenen Senior SAP Interface Cutover Lead. Im Rahmen der Transformation von SAP ECC auf SAP S/4HANA müssen rund 800 Schnittstellen zwischen SAP- und Non-SAP-Systemen koordiniert und im Zuge des Cutovers in die neue Systemlandschaft überführt werden. Ein Großteil der erforderlichen technischen Anpassungen wurde bereits umgesetzt. Gesucht wird ein erfahrener Experte, der den gesamten Schnittstellen-Workstream im Cutover eigenverantwortlich plant, koordiniert und steuert. Drei zwingende Anforderungen: SAP Interface Cutover Management: Nachweisbare persönliche Verantwortung für die Planung und Durchführung eines schnittstellenbezogenen Cutovers innerhalb komplexer SAP-Transformations-, Migrations- oder Carve-out-Projekte. Technisches Schnittstellenverständnis: Fundiertes Verständnis von SAP- und Non-SAP-Integrationen, Schnittstellenabhängigkeiten, Middleware-Technologien sowie der Deaktivierung, Umschaltung, Aktivierung und Validierung von Schnittstellen. Eigenverantwortliche Steuerung: Erfahrung in der Koordination technischer Teams, externer Dienstleister und verschiedener Stakeholder innerhalb großer Transformationsprogramme. Es handelt sich nicht um eine reine SAP-Cutover-Management-Rolle, eine klassische Datenmigrationsrolle oder eine Schnittstellenentwicklerposition. Entscheidend ist die Kombination aus Cutover Management, technischer Integrationskompetenz und eigenverantwortlicher Workstream-Steuerung. Bitte bewirb Dich nur, wenn Du konkrete Projektreferenzen in diesem Umfeld vorweisen kannst. Rahmenbedingungen Start: ASAP Laufzeit: bis Ende März 2028 Auslastung: 100 % Einsatzort: 80 % remote, 20 % Frankfurt am Main Sprache: sehr gutes Deutsch Level: Senior / Lead Vertragsart: Freelance / B2B Bevorzugt Experten mit Standort in Deutschland Tasks Eigenverantwortliche Planung, Koordination und Steuer

Working closely with colleagues across PLOS, you will ensure that editorial strategy, operational delivery, and business performance are aligned in service of PLOS s vision for open science. As a member of PLOS’s senior leadership, you will be part of creating the scholarly communication systems of the future, expanding PLOS s influence and impact globally. You will champion innovation while ensuring that open science, research integrity, efficiency, and author experience remain at the center of how PLOS operates. jobs.description: Site Reliability Engineer UK | Full-Time The Mission: Source.dev Our founders spent over a decade at Google shaping the Android operating systems - building and shipping the software that now runs on billions of devices. They didn't just use Android; they led teams responsible for the Android Virtualization Framework , Security , and the Android Runtime (ART) . Through that journey, they saw a quiet but massive crisis: as device software grew in complexity, the tools used to build it remained stuck in the past. Today, a standard Android checkout exceeds 200GB of code, and builds can take hours. This "wait time" is the single biggest tax on innovation. Source.dev was founded to reimagine software development workflows for device makers. We’re building a new generation of software tools that make building complex device software feel as simple as building a webpage - starting with SourceFS. The Core Product: SourceFS SourceFS is a high-performance virtual filesystem designed to turn multi-hour workflows into minutes. 10x Faster Builds: Intelligent caching and virtualization that only materializes files when they are actually needed. 10x Lower Costs: Enabling a standard 16-vCPU machine to outperform even a 128-vCPU machine. True Engineering Productivity: Replaying hundreds of thousands of build steps instantly when inputs match. The Cultural Anchor: Own It We operate with a high degree of trust and a shared value of End-to-End Ownership : "We own our work end-to-end, from spark to finish. Through our collaborative and committed culture, we find new ways to solve complex problems together and deliver innovative investment opportunities across private markets. Pantheon currently manages approximately $82.3 billion in AUM across all its strategies, serving more than 750 institutional and 638 private wealth clients worldwide For further details please visit www.pantheon.com Purpose of Position The Associate of Private Credit Investment Analytics will help build the development of Pantheon’s private credit data and intelligence capability, transforming investment data into structured, decision-ready insight for Portfolio Management teams.  This role sits at the intersection of Investment, Data and Operations, and will focus on strengthening the firm’s ability to generate consistent, comparable, and actionable intelligence from credit portfolio data — across funds, GPs, structures, and geographies.  The Associate will help architect and operate scalable analytical frameworks that standardize how private credit data is defined, sourced, governed, and translated into insight. The role will partner closely with Portfolio Management, Investment Data Operations and Data Engineering teams to embed credit analytics into Pantheon’s evolving data platforms, reducing reliance on bespoke spreadsheets and increasing transparency, comparability, and confidence  This is a high-impact opportunity to shape Pantheon’s private credit data & analytics capability at a time of significant grow

jobs.description: Growth at United Media Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights. jobs.title: Key Account Manager - France (m/f/x)
jobs.description: At go-e, we have been pursuing the development of our vision with passion and strength from the very beginning. We are moving in an area that is characterized by breakthroughs and growth and that requires a lot of personal responsibility and creative solution finding. On our journey towards the energy transition, the mixture of innovation and security, regional and international, self-realization and professionalism is the ideal fuel for our mutual growth. We are looking for a Key Account Manager (m/f/x) in  Paris , who will help us to expand our customer base in France, where go-e aims to be the market leader for smart charging solutions for electric cars.  With your contribution you will influence how people will charge their cars in the future. Come and join our team that is shaping the future of e-mobility! Your area of responsibility Identify, build and develop customer opportunities in France Development and adaptation of Go-to-Market Strategy Identification of and contact with potential new customers  Support and and further develop the existing customer base  Recognition of market potential and implementation of sales opportunities Preparation of offers and long-term partner contracts  Professional presentation of go-e and our entire product range as well as conducting negotiations  Traveling to new and existing customers in the target area to build up and strengthen relationships Preparation of forecasts, reports and observation of competitors Close cooperation with sales management and internal departments in our headquarters in Feldkirchen in Carinthia (Austria) It would be great if you have Several years of sales experience or experience in supporting key customers  Industry knowledge and technical understanding in the field of e-mobility  Analytical and independent way of working  Willingness to travel throughout France and to our Austrian headquarter  Professional appearance, technical consulting skills

jobs.description: Superviseur de Chantier CVC / Plomberie – Solaire Thermique & BTP (H/F) Informations clés : Référence : 262113S Démarrage : Février 2027 Durée : 2 ans Type de contrat : Freelance ou CDIC Zone géographique : Martinique Déplacements possibles : 100% sur site Rythme d’intervention : Temps Partiel - 1 jour par semaine Contexte de la mission Dans le cadre d’un projet dans le domaine du solaire thermique et des fluides du bâtiment, nous recherchons un(e) Chef de Chantier / Superviseur de Chantier CVC afin d’assurer le suivi des travaux, la coordination des intervenants et le respect des exigences techniques, qualité, sécurité et planning tout au long de la réalisation du projet. Missions Assurer la supervision et le suivi des travaux liés aux installations de solaire thermique et aux fluides du bâtiment Coordonner les entreprises et les différents intervenants présents sur le chantier Contrôler la conformité des installations aux exigences techniques et réglementaires Veiller au respect des règles de sécurité, de qualité et des délais Participer aux réunions de chantier et assurer le reporting régulier de l’avancement des travaux Identifier les écarts techniques ou organisationnels et proposer les actions correctives adaptées Assurer l’interface entre les différents acteurs du projet Accompagner les phases de réception et de levée des réserves Minimum 15 ans d’expérience dans les métiers du bâtiment et du CVC Expérience significative en suivi et supervision de chantier Expérience en outre-mer, idéalement aux Antilles Formation en énergies renouvelables Formation en CVC et plomberie Bonnes connaissances en électricité Bonne maîtrise des problématiques liées aux fluides du bâtiment et aux installations thermiques Connaissance du tissu économique local appréciée Mobilité requise pour des interventions en Martinique 1 jour / semaine Excellentes qualités relationnelles et de communication Ouverture d’esprit, capacité d’adaptation et sens du travail en équipe Autonomie, rigueur

jobs.title: Technical Implementation Manager / Chef.fe de Projet Déploiement Technique
jobs.description: Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides. Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, deux choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission. Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé. 🧩 Notre équipe Customer Operations L'équipe Customer Operations accompagne les établissements de santé dans le déploiement de nos solutions Lifen Documents et Lifen Intégration . Composée de Project Managers et d'Operations Managers, et pilotée par Loïc, elle fait le lien entre nos produits et les équipes hospitalières. Nous recherchons un Technical Implementation Manager , à la croisée de la technique et de la gestion de projet, capable de piloter des déploiements clients tout en prenant en main leur intégration technique. 🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous Tu seras responsable de l'implémentation technique de nos solutions dans les établissements de santé, du cadrage jusqu'à la mise en production. 🔧 Piloter les déploiements techniques Installer et configurer nos applications dans les environnements clients. Mettre en place les flux d'interopérabilité (notamment HL7).

jobs.description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: As an Enterprise Core Sales Engineer at Samsara, you'll be splitting your time across two major focus areas; (1) supporting senior-level sellers in an attempt to grow existing customers, or win new customers, and (2) contributing to the SE Team as a senior resource. There is an expectation that an Enterprise SE is highly accountable for each technical sale, meaning that strong storytelling, objection handling, custom workarounds, advanced integrations, and extensive hands-on experience are requirements to win most deals. Takeaways from these activities should be shared across the SE Team via team meetings, messaging tools, etc. Additionally, an Enterprise Core Sales Engineer is accountable for carving out time to source and deliver product information, conduct testing of alpha products/features, manage projects, and build process improvements and automation that will scale the broader SE Team. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: As an Enterprise Core Sales Engineer at Samsara, you'll be splitting your time across two major focus areas; (1) supporting senior-level sellers in an attempt to grow existing customers, or win new customers, and (2) contributing to the SE Team as a senior resource. There is an expectation that an Enterprise SE is highly accountable for each technical sale, meaning that strong storytelling, objection handling, custom workarounds, advanced integrations, and extensive hands-on experience are requirements to win most deals. L’optimisation des solutions pour garantir performance énergétique, fiabilité et conformité aux normes en vigueur. La réalisation de la mission VISA des études d’exécution des entreprises en charges du lot CFO. Assurer une veille technologique et réglementaire pour intégrer les dernières avancées du secteur. La maitrise de la HTB n’est pas obligatoire mais est très appréciable. jobs.title: Directeur de Projets Datacenter - Marseille H/F
jobs.description: MDC RECRUTEMENT , Cabinet de Recrutement référence dans la filière Datacenter, recherchons pour notre client, acteur majeur du Datacenter, un DIRECTEUR DE PROJETS DATACENTER H/F , dans le cadre de son développement. Vos missions Pilotage de projets : vous dirigez, organisez et planifiez des projets d'envergure en Datacenter, en France comme à l'international. Pilotage technique : vous garantissez la cohérence et la qualité des lots CVC et électricité, de la conception à la mise en service. Performance et satisfaction client : vous pilotez la rentabilité, la qualité et la satisfaction client sur l'ensemble de vos projets. Management d'équipe : vous encadrez et accompagnez les équipes projet, chefs de projets et ingénieurs. Avant-vente : vous participez à la construction des propositions techniques et financières en amont des projets. Cadrage de projet : vous étudiez et mettez en forme l'ensemble des phases des projets, de la conception à la livraison. Relation commerciale : vous menez les rendez-vous clients et prospects conjointement avec la Direction Commerciale, en analysant leurs besoins pour promouvoir les offres du groupe. Comitologie et reporting : vous participez aux comités de pilotage et assurez un reporting régulier, technique, opérationnel et financier, auprès de la Direction, tout en garantissant la gestion financière et contractuelle de vos projets. Le profil recherché Prérequis : 5 ans d'expérience minimum indispensables en pilotage de projets de lots techniques CVC ou électricité (courants forts), en bâtiment, industrie ou infrastructures critiques. Diplôme d'ingénieur généraliste avec spécialisation CVC ou électricité indispensable. Pratique de la comitologie indispensable : participation démontrée à des comités de pilotage et à des reportings réguliers auprès d'une direction. Compétences attendues : Anglais intermédiaire requis, pour des échanges réguliers avec les clients. Sens du commerce et de la relation client, dans la conduite des rendez-vous

jobs.title: HR-Stagiair(e)
jobs.description: Als HR‑Stagiair(e) draai je bij ons mee in het HR‑team en krijg je de kans om veel te leren, met een duidelijke focus op Learning & Development. Je werkt mee aan verschillende HR- en L&D‑activiteiten en krijgt daarnaast de ruimte om je stage zelf vorm te geven en te ontdekken welke andere HR‑onderwerpen jou aanspreken. Zo doe je brede praktijkervaring op in een omgeving waar veel gebeurt en waar je actief kunt bijdragen. Jouw stage: Je werkt mee in ons team van 10 HR‑professionals met expertise in o.a. onboarding, L&D, verzuim, recruitment, employer branding en HR‑advies. Je krijgt veel vrijheid én goede begeleiding om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Waar draag je aan bij? Het versterken van vaardigheden en ontwikkeling binnen de organisatie door mee te werken aan L&D‑projecten. Het soepel laten verlopen van soft skills trainingen, door ondersteuning bij voorbereiding, communicatie en coördinatie. De verbetering van HR‑processen door het initiëren en uitvoeren van eigen HR‑projecten (bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van onboarding, recruitment of procesoptimalisatie). Events rondom arbeidsmarktcommunicatie, workshops rond duurzame inzetbaarheid en onboardingsactiviteiten. Een correcte en overzichtelijke HR‑administratie, zoals het opstellen van contracten, brieven en personele mutaties. Continue verbetering binnen HR door actieve deelname aan HR‑overleggen en het meedenken over verbeteringen. Onze organisatie beweegt snel: er gebeurt veel en geen week is hetzelfde. Dat biedt enorm veel leerkansen, maar vraagt ook dat jij zelf richting geeft aan je stage en je weg vindt in een dynamische omgeving. Je krijgt van ons goede begeleiding, maar het is aan jou om kansen te zien en initiatief te tonen. Wat breng je mee? We zoeken een stagiair(e) die: Een hbo‑opleiding HRM volgt (3e of 4e jaar) en stage wil lopen vanaf februari 2027. Beschikbaar is voor 4 of 5 dagen per week. Geïnteresseerd is in Learning & Development. Sterk is in Nederlands en goed overweg kan met Engels. Nauwkeurig werkt

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Python & Cloud)
jobs.description: Build the software behind large-scale battery storage Solar and wind power are not always available when we need electricity. Large-scale battery storage helps by storing electricity when supply is abundant and releasing it when demand rises. This keeps the grid flexible and reduces reliance on fossil fuels. But how do you connect a battery site of hundreds of megawatts to a central IT platform? And how do you build software that is ready for the projects still to come? As a Software Engineer at GIGA Storage, these are the challenges you will work on. About GIGA Storage Founded in 2018, we are an international scale-up growing across the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany. Our purpose, ‘Unlock every Green Watt’, is about making the energy system better and more affordable for future generations. We aim to have 1.5 to 2 GW of battery power operational by 2030. At 2 GW, that is theoretically enough peak power to supply more than a million homes simultaneously. We pioneer at a scale where many solutions are still being developed. We take ownership, share knowledge and make decisions together. Rapid growth also calls for adaptability: priorities shift and not everything is defined in advance. jobs.title: Marketing-Managerin (w/m/d) Retail & Franchise
jobs.description: Brænder du for brands, tænker du iværksætteragtigt, og har du energien til virkelig at sætte gang i tingene? Wenn du nicht nur Kampagnen verwalten, sondern als starker Sparring-Partner echte unternehmerische Erfolge vor Ort mitgestalten willst, dann bist du hier genau richtig. Wir suchen eine proaktive Macher-Persönlichkeit mit Teamgeist, die unsere internationale dänische Design-Marke im deutschen Markt auf das nächste Level hebt – und unsere Franchisenehmer zu echten „Local Heroes“ macht! Hier wirst du sicherlich nicht jeden Tag dasselbe machen, du wirst viel allein arbeiten, aber immer im Austausch mit dem Team, den Stores und Agenturen stehen, du wirst reisen und kannst dich auf ein internationales Umfeld freuen, in dem du persönlich wie fachlich wachsen kannst. Dein zukünftiger Arbeitgeber Unser Auftraggeber ist ein international tätiges Unternehmen aus dem Küchen- und Einrichtungsumfeld, das für Preistransparenz, Nachhaltigkeit und Qualität steht. Das aus Dänemark stammende Konzept besteht seit 1983, ist heute mit mehr als 180 Studios in 13 Ländern vertreten und eines der digitalsten Unternehmen der Branche. Du hast Lust, uns zu unterstützen und mit uns gemeinsam zu wachsen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! Aufgaben Retail-Marketing: Du adaptierst unsere internationale Marketingstrategie für den deutschen Markt, steuerst nationale wie regionale Kampagnen und sorgst durch gezielte Initiativen für volle Showrooms und messbaren ROI bei Neueröffnungen sowie Bestands-Stores. Local Hero Marketing: Du entwickelst individuelle lokale Konzepte, aktivierst regionale Medien, Events sowie Kooperationen und stärkst die Sichtbarkeit unserer Franchisenehmer direkt in ihren Communities. Steuerung von Digital-Kampagnen & Agenturen: Du arbeitest eng zusammen mit Media-Agenturen sowie internen Spezialisten (Digital, E-Commerce, Content), analysierst relevante KPIs und treibst den Einsatz innovativer, KI-gestützter Marketing-Lösungen voran. PR & Micro-Influencer-Marketing

jobs.description: About Us Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. Hawk builds AI-powered financial crime detection (AML, transaction monitoring, and fraud prevention) for global tier-1 banks, payment processors, and high-growth fintechs. Because our platform analyzes real-time payment streams and sensitive financial data, security is not an administrative support function—it is our primary product promise. We are looking for a technically grounded, hands-on CISO to own our global security posture end-to-end. This is a true player-coach leadership role. You will lead a dedicated team of four domain specialists while staying close enough to the technology to review cloud architecture, triage high-severity vulnerabilities, command critical incident responses first-hand, and debate technical security controls peer-to-peer with customer bank CISOs. Why This Role Matters Global Regulatory Scrutiny at Scale: We operate across key financial hubs including Germany, the UK, the US, Singapore, and a growing roster of international markets. With DORA enforceable across the EU and heightened ICT risk rules globally, our banking clients expect documented operational resilience, continuous testing, and verified controls across all jurisdictions. Technische Lösungen fürs Team umsetzen. Du klärst Anforderungen mit den Kollegen, führst bei Bedarf neue Tools ein und hilfst bei technischen Fragen zu unseren

jobs.title: Founding Product Designer
jobs.description: EU Remote (CET preferred) · German & English · Full-time Competitive salary · Early equity YOUR MISSION A software engineer today works alongside Claude Code or Cursor. A mechanical engineer designing the next jet engine still clicks through CAD trees, searches Excel sheets and asks whoever has been around longest. We are building the AI co-engineer for physical products : one that works natively in 3D and learns from real engineering decisions. We are in production with major European manufacturers. The interaction model is still an open problem. How does an engineer give an agent context, steer its work and understand what changed? How much should the agent figure out itself? And how does all of this fit into existing CAD and engineering workflows? You will work directly with founders, engineers and customers to figure that out and turn it into a product people can actually use. You are our first full-time product designer. We want someone with a point of view who can help shape the direction, not someone waiting for a finished brief. WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON You will work across discovery, interaction design and shipped product. We cannot say exactly what that looks like in month three, but these are the kinds of problems in front of us: How engineers work with AI agents in 3D. Briefing, steering, reviewing and understanding agent work without turning the product into another complex engineering tool. Connecting AI into real engineering workflows. Spend time with customers, understand how they actually work, test ideas early and turn what you learn into better product decisions. Prototyping new interaction models. Sometimes that means Figma, sometimes a rough prototype in code, sometimes pairing directly with an engineer. Use whatever gets us to an answer fastest. jobs.title: Finance Lead (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Description We are building a Finance function that enables our next phase of growth – and we're looking for someone who wants to build it with us. As our Finance Lead , you will take end-to-end ownership of our financial operations, laying the financial foundation for a scaling deep-tech hardware company. From accounting, reporting, controlling and treasury to public funding and the financial infrastructure supporting global equipment deliveries, you will play a central role in how QuantumDiamonds grows. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will work closely with our leadership team, investors and external partners, translating business priorities into sound financial decisions and scalable processes. This is a hands-on build role, not a position where you simply oversee an established Finance department. You will work with a lean team, take ownership of operational and strategic topics, and actively leverage technology, AI and automation to build an efficient Finance function that scales alongside the business. We're looking for someone who brings strong Finance foundations, sound judgment, and the ambition to take on broader responsibilities as the company grows. You don't need to have done everything before – but you should be excited to figure things out, take ownership, and make things happen. Who we are Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing. jobs.description: At remberg, you’ll help to keep the world running. Everything that gets produced relies on a maintenance team behind the scenes that keeps the machines, equipment and infrastructure running. We are helping these teams by simplifying their work with modern, agentic maintenance software. At remberg, we are serving clients like Remondis, Würth, Edeka, Rotkäppchen and 300+ more. jobs.title: Senior Sales Engineer - UK
jobs.description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. As a Senior Sales Engineer at Samsara, you'd be part of a diverse group of both technically and business minded folks working together to bring our unique connected operations technology to customers. Our daily customer engagements include conversations around logistics/supply chain management, fleet management and maintenance strategies, global asset management, system integrations, and regulatory compliance. This means a successful Sales Engineer at Samsara will develop a thorough understanding of IoT hardware and sensors, hands-on installation/deployment scenarios, carrier networks, cloud infrastructure, and third-party system integrations (via our open API) to ensure the proper technical solution is presented to our customers. This is a unique opportunity to support and grow a key market for Samsara in close collaboration with other areas of the business: Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Technical Support, and Customer Success. jobs.title: SAP Engineer
jobs.description: TL;DR: We're looking for exceptional SAP engineers eager to build the AI layer for operating the world’s most complex IT setups. This role moves beyond just ABAP: you’ll develop software across the stack, design AI harnesses and agents, influence product direction, and work with customers. Why Conduct Today, no single person fully understands their ERP setup: decades of customisation, millions of lines of ABAP, and undocumented changes from thousands of consultants has led to spiralling complexity. As a result, projects take years and migrations costs hundreds of millions. Conduct lets IT teams run faster. Teams collaborate alongside AI agents to accelerate their work, be it fit-gap analyses, hypercare support, deciphering business processes, writing ABAP, and more. We believe this is a generation-defining mission: by accelerating IT, businesses can evolve faster, unlocking productivity across industries. Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems, we just closed a $50M+ Series A from top-tier funds, and we're still early enough that what you build here defines the company. We're a small, talent-dense team doing our life's work at Conduct. We value ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. If you bring that same drive, we'll make sure this is the place you do yours too. Who We Hire We're looking for an developer who understands ABAP inside out, down into implementation and runtime details, and is excited about what becomes possible when you put AI on top of it. You'll stand out if you: Have experience of hands-on ABAP and SAP development experience: technical consultant, ABAP developer, solutions architect, or similar Understand how SAP systems are actually structured beneath the surface: data models, BAPIs, IDocs, function modules, enhancement frameworks Have worked within or alongside large SAP implementations and migrations, understanding the complexities that arise from these Are eager to work beyond ABAP, including in writing

jobs.description: ABOUT THE ROLE Many of the capabilities behind our products, and the experience our players get, come from third-party suppliers. As our Supplier Manager, you'll own a portfolio of those suppliers. You're the person they talk to, and the person Product turns to for what a supplier can do, how it's performing and what it costs. You'll join our Supplier Management team in Core Experience, part of Product & Technology. The team is based in Stockholm and Malta, and this role sits in Malta or UK (Leeds). The Fastline: Each domain has its own Fastline: a small team of Staff Engineers working across all the products of the domain, in a highly agile, commando mode. The Fastline is transverse to the domain’s products: it is not attached to one product, but deployed wherever a domain needs senior engineering firepower the most. The Fastline takes on three kinds of work: Complex features in existing products: deliver features too risky, cross-cutting or technically hard for a product team to absorb alongside its committed roadmap. Legacy decommissioning: retire legacy systems safely, migrate their capabilities and data, and switch them off for good. IS simplification: reduce the complexity of the tribe’s information system, remove duplication, and make the architecture easier to run and evolve. Fastlines are attached to the Domain Lead, who sets their priorities based on business value, in coordination with the domains’ Lead ITs. Missions are short and outcome-driven: you join a topic, deliver, hand over to the owning product team, and move on to the next one. 🎯 TASK Strategic & Hard Problems Take on the domain’s most difficult and strategic topics: legacy decommissioning, IS simplification, complex features in existing products.
